note: Triennial election of the county council, 1930: nominations received by T. E. Reid, secretary, 29 April 1930; after withdrawals there was no contest in the county. Returned unopposed. The Belfast News-Letter prints his label as "U.", apparently a misprint (he is "N." in the 1924 lists); no label is filed.
